messages.content: Write a complete 180–220 word literary flash fiction. It must open with the exact sentence ‘The elevator stopped between two forgotten floors.’ Use a brass key and the smell of rain as recurring motifs, reveal a quiet change in the protagonist rather than a plot twist, and end with the exact sentence ‘This time, she chose the stairs.’ Do not use headings.
写一篇完整的中文微型小说，控制在 220–300 个汉字。第一句必须是“末班地铁停在了不存在的站台。”，让旧车票和桂花香成为反复出现的意象，人物应发生细微但可信的内在变化，不要依赖反转；最后一句必须是“天亮前，他把车票留在了风里。”。不要加标题。

Rewrite the following into a warm, concise professional email of at most 130 words. Preserve every fact and date, make the requested action explicit, and avoid blame: ‘The migration was supposed to happen on 14 September but the inventory spreadsheet was not finished. We can now do it on 21 September from 19:00 to 21:00 UTC. The service may be read-only for up to 35 minutes. Team leads have to confirm their owner list by 18 September at noon UTC, otherwise accounts without owners will be postponed. Send confirmations to Mira and copy the operations list.’

把下面内容改写成语气体谅、信息清楚的内部通知，不超过 180 个汉字；所有数字、日期和行动要求都必须保留，不推卸责任：“原计划 9 月 14 日迁移，但资产表没有完成。现调整为 9 月 21 日 19:00–21:00（UTC），服务最多只读 35 分钟。各组负责人须在 9 月 18 日 12:00（UTC）前确认负责人清单，未确认的无负责人账号将延期。请把确认发给 Mira，并抄送运维邮件组。”

Summarize the passage below in exactly four bullets for an executive reader. Each bullet must be one sentence and cover, in order: finding, mechanism, limitation, next decision. Do not invent numbers. Passage: A six-week pilot compared scheduled battery charging with ad-hoc charging across twelve delivery vans. Scheduled charging reduced peak-grid draw by 18 percent while all routes still departed on time. The effect came mainly from staggering the first hour of charging and delaying non-urgent top-ups until after midnight. The pilot ran in mild weather at one depot, used a stable route plan, and did not test winter range loss or emergency dispatch. The team must now decide whether to extend the pilot to the northern depot for a winter trial before purchasing the fleet-wide control software.

把下面材料概括成恰好四个项目符号，供管理层阅读；每项只能一句话，并依次写：发现、机制、局限、下一步决策。不得虚构数字。材料：一项为期六周的试点，在 12 辆配送车上比较了定时充电与临时充电。定时充电使电网峰值负荷下降 18%，同时所有车辆都按时出发。效果主要来自错开首小时充电，并把不紧急的补电推迟到午夜后。试点只在气候温和的一个车场进行，路线计划稳定，未测试冬季续航损失或紧急调度。团队现在要决定，是否先在北部车场开展冬季试点，再购买全车队控制软件。

Explain speculative decoding to a technically curious product manager in 200–260 words. Use one clear analogy, then state where the analogy breaks. Distinguish latency from throughput, explain why rejected draft tokens do not change the final answer, and include one concrete reason acceptance rate can fall. Avoid equations and marketing language.
用 260–360 个汉字向懂一些技术的产品经理解释“推测解码”。先用一个清楚的类比，再说明类比在哪里失效；区分延迟与吞吐，解释草稿 token 被拒绝为何不会改变最终答案，并给出一个接受率下降的具体原因。不要写公式，不要使用营销腔。

Write a balanced 220–280 word editorial arguing whether a city library should remain open until midnight during exam season. Take a clear position, present the strongest opposing argument fairly, answer it without dismissing it, and propose one measurable six-week pilot. Use a calm civic tone and no bullet points.
写一篇 300–420 个汉字的短评，讨论城市图书馆是否应在考试季开放到午夜。必须明确表态，公平呈现反方最有力的论点，再认真回应，并提出一个可衡量的六周试点方案。语气理性克制，不要使用项目符号。

Write exactly ten lines of dialogue, alternating MAYA and ELI, beginning with MAYA. They are repairing a community radio during a storm. Neither may directly say they are afraid. By line 8, reveal through subtext that ELI plans to leave town; line 10 must contain the words ‘signal is clear’. Use no narration and keep every line under 18 words.
写恰好十行中文对话，由“林：”和“乔：”交替，第一行是林。两人在暴雨中修理社区电台，谁都不能直接说自己害怕；第八行之前要通过潜台词透露乔准备离开这座城；第十行必须包含“信号清楚了”。不要写旁白，每行不超过 22 个汉字。
